mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <= 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <= 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when both series are above their 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 230 indicates elevated inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <= 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weak manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in <= 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1000 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <= 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market, which typically supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile and UNRATE is below its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 13000 billion dollars (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in <= 50% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 13000.
